title: 学术绘图
description:
Generate a clean, professional academic framework diagram on a pure white background, strictly following NeurIPS 2025 visual conventions. 

Style & Palette: Agent-narrative aesthetic. Use soft pastel, scientific color palettes (muted tones of pale blue, sea-green, light lavender, and pale amber). Strictly avoid overly saturated or eye-burning primary colors. Use clean black outlines and minimal gradients.

Visual Semantics: 
- Data/Storage: Use cylinders.
- Processing/Modules: Use rounded rectangles.
- Tensors/Features/Data Flows: Use grids.
- Complex representations: Use stacked layers.
- Status Icons: Integrate minimal academic icons organically (🔥 for trainable components, ❄️ for frozen models, 🔍 for retrieval mechanisms, 🧠 for memory).

Content & Layout Detail (Strictly ordered by spatial data flow):
1. Top Section (Data Input): Left is a cylinder "风险原始日志" feeding into a rounded rectangle "数据处理 (❄️)". This outputs a grid "轨迹数据流", which flows right into a bar chart "指标反馈" (Precision, Recall, F1).
2. Left Middle Section (Representation Learning): A container labeled "对比样本构建". Inside, stacked layers "正样本对生成" and "困难负采样" flow into a rounded rectangle "种子挖掘 (🔍)". This interacts with a cylinder "黑种子轨迹表".
3. Right Middle Section (Multi-Agent Analyzer): A large main rounded rectangle container "协作多智能体分析器". Inside, top left is a globe/network icon for "全局上下文与知识库". Top right are three agent icons: "多样性智能体", "规则优化智能体 (🔥)", "专家知识智能体". Below them are two sub-modules: "记忆系统 (🧠)" and "人工规则指导". The container outputs right to a monitor icon "鉴别与填补指导".
4. Bottom Left Section (Storage & Retrieval): Cylinders and grids for "黑种子轨迹存储" and "特征存储表" feed into a large rounded rectangle "大规模向量检索 (🔍)".
5. Bottom Right Section (Training & Deployment): An arrow "规则发现知识" flows from retrieval into a rounded rectangle "模型训练与规则发现系统 (🔥)". This flows into "性能评估" (which has a feedback loop back to the multi-agent analyzer), and finally outputs to a monitor icon "线上检测 (🔥)" and a cylinder "部署".

Typography & Clarity: Keep all Chinese text labels minimalistic, highly legible, and properly aligned. Ensure clear, orthogonal black arrows indicating complex data flows and feedback loops. Avoid visual clutter, ensuring rigorous academic structural alignment.
